about.title: About Litore
about.intro: Litore is a UAE store specialising in cosmetic coloured contact lenses, with a soft feminine identity and a simple, safe shopping experience.
sections: What we offer
Cosmetic coloured lenses in a range of shades, each clearly described: colour, size, wear duration and lenses per pack, so you can choose with confidence.
Our promise
Clear prices and specifications, clean packaging, fast WhatsApp support, and fair policies for both customer and store.
Important
Cosmetic lenses are worn on the eye. We always recommend consulting an eye-care professional before first use and following the pack instructions.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Quick answers to what you ask most.
sections: How do I choose the right colour?
Start with the colour guide or Find your lens, based on your natural eye colour and the look you want (natural or bold). Appearance may vary slightly with lighting.
Which payment methods are available?
Cash on delivery, and online payment by card, Apple Pay or Samsung Pay when enabled in the store. The methods available appear at checkout.
How long does delivery take?
1 to 3 working days within the UAE after your order is confirmed.
Can I return lenses?
Yes, within 14 days of delivery for sealed, unused packs. Opened packs cannot be returned for hygiene reasons unless the product is defective or incorrect. See the Returns page.
How do I track my order?
Use the Track order page with your order number, or message us on WhatsApp.
Are lenses suitable for everyone?
No. If you have allergies, inflammation, severe dryness or vision problems, consult your doctor before use.

shipping.title: Shipping & delivery
shipping.intro: We deliver quickly with clean packaging that protects your lenses.
sections: Delivery time
Within the UAE: 1 to 3 working days after order confirmation. Working days exclude Fridays, Saturdays and public holidays; delays may occur during peak seasons or for reasons beyond our control.
Shipping fees
Shipping fees are shown clearly at checkout before you confirm. Free shipping may apply above a certain order value when announced in the store.
Tracking
Once shipped, the tracking number appears on the Track order page and we can send it on WhatsApp on request.
Receiving your order

The courier will call the phone number you provided. Please make sure the address and number are correct and be available at delivery. After two failed attempts the order may be returned to us and cancelled in coordination with you.
Cash on delivery
With cash on delivery, payment is made to the courier on delivery. We reserve the right to disable this option for accounts that repeatedly refuse delivery without reason.
Other GCC countries
We are enabling shipping to other GCC countries gradually. Available countries, times and fees appear at checkout.
Damaged or missing parcel
Check the parcel on receipt. If you notice visible damage or missing items, tell us within 48 hours on WhatsApp with photos.

returns.title: Returns & exchanges
returns.intro: A fair policy that respects eye health, your rights as a customer and the store's rights, in line with UAE consumer protection rules.
sections: Return period
You may request a return or exchange within 14 days of delivery.
Conditions

• The pack is fully sealed, unopened and unused.
• The safety seal and original packaging are intact.
• You provide your order number.
Why we don't accept opened packs
Lenses touch the eye and reselling an opened pack could harm health, so we cannot accept opened or used packs for a change of mind or colour.
Defective or wrong items

If you receive a manufacturing defect, a wrong item or a damaged item, we will exchange it or refund in full at our cost including shipping, even if the pack is open, provided you tell us within 14 days with clear photos of the pack and product.
How to request
Message us on WhatsApp +971 52 764 5570 with your order number and the reason. We will reply with the steps. Return shipping for a change of mind is paid by the customer.
Refunds
After we receive and inspect the return, the amount is refunded to the original payment method, or by bank transfer for cash on delivery, within 14 days of inspection.
Cancellation
An order can be cancelled before it ships by contacting us on WhatsApp.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: We respect your privacy and process your data in line with the UAE Personal Data Protection Law (Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021) and applicable legislation.
sections: Who is responsible

LITORE COSMETICS — Individual establishment — Economic licence no. CN-6352237 — Department of Economic Development, Abu Dhabi — Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates — Email: memelitore@gmail.com — WhatsApp: +971 52 764 5570
Data we collect

Name, email, phone number, delivery address, order details, a password (stored hashed; we cannot read it), and anything you write in reviews, complaints or suggestions. We collect this data only to improve the quality of your service and your shopping experience, and for no other purpose.
Why we use it
To fulfil and deliver your order, provide customer care, manage your account, prevent fraud and meet legal obligations. We do not sell your data.
Who we share it with
Only what is needed to fulfil your order: shipping carriers, payment providers once enabled, hosting providers, and authorities when legally required.
Cookies

We use essential cookies for sign-in, your cart and your preferences. With your consent we also use optional cookies to understand how the store is used and improve your experience. You can change your choice any time from “Cookie settings” at the bottom of the page. If you accept optional cookies we record an anonymous visit (page, device type, browser and where you came from) without storing your IP address or anything that identifies you, so we can improve the store.
Retention & security
We keep data as long as needed for the purpose or required by law (such as invoices) and protect it with encrypted connections, hashed passwords and limited access.
Your rights
You may request access, correction or deletion of your data, or object to processing, by messaging us on WhatsApp +971 52 764 5570 or the email above. We will reply within a reasonable time.
Updates
We may update this policy and show the last update date here. Last updated: [approval date].

care.title: Care & use
care.intro: General safety guidance. Always follow the pack instructions and your eye-care professional's advice, which come first.
sections: Before wearing
Wash your hands with soap and water and dry them well; check the lens, expiry date and solution.
While wearing
Do not use lenses with water (swimming, showering), do not share them, and do not sleep in them unless designed for it.
Care & storage
Use fresh lens solution only, never water or saliva, replace the lens case regularly, and keep lenses in solution.
Replacement
Follow the wear duration on the pack (daily/monthly/yearly) and do not exceed it.
When to stop
Stop immediately and see a doctor if you have pain, redness, excess tears, blurred vision or light sensitivity.
Important
This guidance is general and does not replace medical advice.
